subject: Beautification Ordinance Framework
overview: The subcommittee reviewed a draft ordinance to create a new advisory commission and discussed ongoing municipal beautification efforts. The body voted to open a public comment period to gather feedback on the proposal's structure.

items.title: Review of Current Beautification Initiatives
items.summary: Chief of Staff Nina Nazarian briefed the committee on ongoing city projects, including light post maintenance, signage improvements, and upcoming cleanup events.

items.title: Draft Beautification Ordinance Presentation
items.summary: City Solicitor Kimberly Scanlon presented a draft framework for an advisory commission that would recommend projects to improve the appearance of public areas.

items.title: Discussion of Commission Structure and Compensation
items.summary: Councilors discussed membership qualifications, geographic representation, and the potential for compensating volunteers to improve diversity and equity on city boards.

items.title: Motion for Public Comment
items.summary: Approved a motion to hold a six-day public comment period via email regarding the commission's purpose, membership size, and meeting frequency.

items.title: Matter Kept in Committee
items.summary: The paper was kept in committee pending public feedback.
